method: Every applicable geometry from actual NRN encoded WGS84 segments and AEB features (independent game WGS84 reprojection) plus exact native emitted sidewalk/parking bounding boxes. Whole-support reserve is 4sqrt2 m on road and 4 m against an axis-aligned box; conservative count is for centres entering complete intended larger guard, not only positive 2m centres on mesh. Regions farther than 25m cannot violate the intended 20m/15.5m/13.5m fences. AABB clearance is L∞ conservative.
